question: Which home team had lost the fewest matches in the 2016 season?
evidence: home team lost the matches refers to SUBTRACT(home_team_goal, away_team_goal) < 0; 2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016';
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT teamDetails.team_long_name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC) AS __r FROM Match AS matchData INNER JOIN Team AS teamDetails ON matchData.home_team_api_id = teamDetails.team_api_id WHERE matchData.season = '2015/2016' AND matchData.home_team_goal - matchData.away_team_goal < 0 GROUP BY matchData.home_team_api_id) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT teamDetails.team_long_name FROM Match AS matchData INNER JOIN Team AS teamDetails ON matchData.home_team_api_id = teamDetails.team_api_id WHERE matchData.season = '2015/2016' AND matchData.home_team_goal - matchData.away_team_goal < 0 GROUP BY matchData.home_team_api_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which home team lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season (a home loss being a match where home_team_goal minus away_team_goal is less than 0)? If several teams tie for the fewest losses, return all of them.
d.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT home_team_api_id, SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal - away_team_goal < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY home_team_api_id) SELECT t.team_long_name, l.losses FROM l JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = l.home_team_api_id WHERE l.losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM l)

b.request: Which home team had the fewest home-match losses (home_team_goal < away_team_goal) in the 2015/2016 season, returning all teams tied for the lowest count if there are ties?
b.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT home_team_api_id, SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses FROM "Match" WHERE season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY home_team_api_id) SELECT t.team_long_name, l.losses FROM l JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = l.home_team_api_id WHERE l.losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM l)

c.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT home_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS losses FROM Match WHERE season = '2015/2016' AND home_team_goal - away_team_goal < 0 GROUP BY home_team_api_id) SELECT t.team_long_name, c.losses FROM c JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = c.home_team_api_id WHERE c.losses = (SELECT MIN(losses) FROM c)
